chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played All Streams Flow to the Sea on Sludge Spinner, then Water's Edge on Sludge Spinner, then Coral Guard. This uses all 3 energy, deals 15 known damage, and gains 5 Block before the telegraphed 8 damage attack.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered playing Watatsumi Levy with one of the 1-cost cards to spend Charge and Muster 2, but I rejected it because Muster transforms cards into random Inazuma Companion cards and the page gives no information about what those cards would be or how useful they would be.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: The chosen line gave up spending Charge and the possible random card generation from Watatsumi Levy. It also left Charge at 8 and did not create any Inazuma Companion cards, prioritizing the known immediate damage and Block instead.
answers.q4_different_intent: No. A different telegraphed intent would not have changed the line, because the chosen cards are all affordable and provide known immediate value: 15 damage and 5 Block. Without information making the random Muster result reliably better, no other known line is clearly superior.
